summary: Boston Scientific disclosed an accelerated share repurchase (ASR) agreement with JPMorgan for $2 billion of its common stock, part of a previously authorized $5 billion repurchase program. Under the ASR, the company will receive shares worth 80% of the repurchase price based on the May 15, 2026 closing price of $52.68, representing approximately 30.4 million shares initially. Final share count will depend on VWAP during the term less a discount, with final settlement expected by June 30, 2026. After completion, $3 billion remains under authorization. This capital return program signals management's view of undervaluation and commitment to shareholder returns; watch for volume-weighted price dynamics and potential early completion.
